description: This Java class defines a Fragment named LogFragment that displays a log view within an Android application. It creates a ScrollView containing a custom LogView, configures visual styles and padding, and updates scroll position when the log text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView. It handles view creation and updates the scroll position when new log entries are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets styling and padding, and returns the top-level view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
